scenes.say: Why do you crash at 3pm every single day?
It's not your sleep. And more coffee makes it worse.
A lunch of white rice and juice spikes your blood sugar, then drops it.
But here's the part nobody tells you.
Try three small swaps at lunch this week.
Even a ten minute walk after eating helps flatten the dip.
scenes.label: walk after lunch flattens the dip

scenes.say: Save this, and try it before your next 3pm crash.
